findings.title: Key missing from Secret
findings.cause: container api reads key DB_PASSWORD from Secret db, which has no such key; it has db-password, which differs only in case and separators (- _ .); Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: couldn't find key DB_PASSWORD in Secret kd-secret-key-case/db

evidence.what: Secret db has keys db-password, not DB_PASSWORD
evidence.command: kubectl get secret db -n kd-secret-key-case -o go-template='{{range $k, $v := .data}}{{$k}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}'

findings.fix: Read key db-password, as Secret db spells it, or rename the key in Secret db to DB_PASSWORD.
